calibration.source: WorkBuddy corner watermark sample on a near-black lower border.
calibration.measurement: The black-background observation estimates premultiplied color T=alpha*W.
calibration.supported_conditions: Same text rendering, color, opacity and encoded RGB compositing; integer translation or isotropic native/canvas scale.

notes: This profile describes the two supplied samples only, not all WorkBuddy exports. The profile contains an extracted watermark layer rather than either complete source image. Rotation, crop, altered fonts/opacity, color management, JPEG damage and unusual resizing can cause a deliberate no-match result. Scores are heuristic similarities, not calibrated probabilities.
